item.text: The SCoG archives contain IQ-TREE reports alongside the inferred gene trees. import io, re, zipfile, statistics, math

for archive in (\"inputs/scogs_animals.zip\", \"inputs/scogs_fungi.zip\"):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
        reports = sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith(\".iqtree\"))
        vals = []
        rows = []
        for n in reports:
            s = z.read(n).decode(\"utf-8\", \"replace\")
            mt = re.search(r\"Total tree length \\(sum of branch lengths\\):\\s*([0-9.eE+-]+)\", s)
            mi = re.search(r\"Sum of internal branch lengths:\\s*([0-9.eE+-]+)\\s*\\(([0-9.eE+-]+)% of tree length\\)\", s)
            if not (mt and mi):
                print(\"MISSING\", archive, n, bool(mt), bool(mi))
                continue
            total = float(mt.group(1))
            internal = float(mi.group(1))
            pct = float(mi.group(2))
            vals.append(pct/100)
            rows.append((n, total, internal, pct/100, internal/total))
        print(\"\\n\", archive)
        print(\"reports\", len(reports), \"parsed\", len(vals))
        print(\"median_report_decimal\", statistics.median(vals))
        print(\"median_ratio_from_rounded_report_sums\", statistics.median(r[4] for r in rows))
        print(\"minmax\", min(vals), max(vals))
        print(\"first5\")
        for r in rows[:5]:
            print(r)
        # compare report percent to exact ratio in each treefile
        diffs=[]
        for n,total,internal,pct,ratio in rows:
            tree_name=n[:-len(\".iqtree\")] + \".treefile\"
            if tree_name in z.namelist():
                # no parser yet; just ensure corresponding file
                pass
        print(\"treefiles corresponding\", sum((n[:-len(\".iqtree\")] + \".treefile\") in z.namelist() for n in reports))

import re, zipfile, statistics, math

class Node:
    __slots__ = (\"children\",\"length\",\"name\")
    def __init__(self, children=None, length=None, name=None):
        self.children = children or []
        self.length = length
        self.name = name

def parse_newick(s):
    s=s.strip()
    i=0
    def skip():
        nonlocal i
        while i<len(s) and s[i].isspace(): i+=1
    def token(stop):
        nonlocal i
        start=i
        while i<len(s) and s[i] not in stop: i+=1
        return s[start:i].strip()
    def length():
        nonlocal i
        skip()
        if i<len(s) and s[i]==\":\":
            i+=1; skip()
            start=i
            while i<len(s) and s[i] not in \",();\": i+=1
            return float(s[start:i].strip())
